findings.title: .audits/index.json nightly_audits array missing 20260622T041450Z.json
findings.detail: The audit file 20260622T041450Z.json exists on disk and the index last_updated is 2026-06-22T04:14:50Z, but the nightly_audits array was not updated to include it. The array ends at 20260620T041100Z.json. Any tooling that reads nightly_audits for the audit history will not see the 2026-06-22 scan.
findings.fix_sketch: Append '20260622T041450Z.json' to the nightly_audits array in .audits/index.json.
